subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` display setting for model-visible envelope, direct-prefix, and system-event dates, and what enum/scope should it use?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new config surface, and this change would alter model-visible timestamp strings across prompt composition rather than fixing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow enum
options.body: Accept `iso` as the default and add a small explicit enum for human-display date ordering across all prompt-facing timestamp surfaces, with docs and focused tests.

options.title: Keep ISO-only
options.body: Decline the new config field and document that prompt-facing dates stay ISO for sortability and reduced ambiguity.

options.title: Request a small RFC first
options.body: Ask the reporter or a maintainer to settle scope details such as `locale`, direct-prefix behavior, and timestamp-detection compatibility before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow enum
recommendation.body: Accept `iso` as the default and add a small explicit enum for human-display date ordering across all prompt-facing timestamp surfaces, with docs and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about OpenClaw's public config contract and model-visible timestamp semantics, and this person has the strongest combined history on config, envelope, and date/time behavior.
